en: <CLT=cltMIND>There's still some time left—
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*ding dong...*

<CLT=cltMIND>Huh? I guess that's Kaito, but...
is he here to train already?

<CLT=cltMIND>Weren't we supposed to train at night?
It's a little early...

<CLT=cltMIND>I feel like it's too early for
Kaito to be here...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>Then, the moment I opened the door...
Sh-Shuichi, run!
Huh!? What happened!?

Don't just stand there, run!
Hurry! <CLT=cltSTRONG>He's<CLT=cltNORMAL> coming!
Who's coming?
Gh!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito risked a glance down the hallway
and immediately stiffened up in fear.

Damn it...he's already here!
Hurry, Shuichi! Run!

If we both make it out of this alive...
Let's train again.
Ah! Kaito!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito gave his ominous warning,
then ran away at lightning speed.
Wh-What!? <CLT=cltSTRONG>Who<CLT=cltNORMAL> are you talking about?

I peeked through the gap in the doorway
to discover what Kaito was so terrified by.
Huh...?

<CLT=cltMIND>That's...Gonta, isn't it?
He looks...different...
What's going on...?

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like he's checking each room.
He'll be at my door soon...

I don't know what he's up to, but it's
probably better not to be here...

<CLT=cltMIND>Careful to avoid alerting Gonta,
I quietly tiptoed down the hall.
<CLT=cltMIND>I stealthily made my way to the courtyard.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's so clunky...
I wonder if that's just what Monokuma likes.

<CLT=cltMIND>I usually slept on a futon at home.
I don't really like sleeping on beds...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>Who prepared all of this? And how?
Why give us so many spare uniforms?
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito's <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltMIND> is on here...

<CLT=cltMIND>We promised not to tell each other
who has whose <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltMIND>.
